scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify build error from binlog (missing file copy)

rubricScores.criterion: Identified the MSB3030 error (could not copy file)
Included the full file path that was not found
Mentioned what the copy target was trying to do (copy a project output file)
Noted the target framework (net8.0-windows) involved in the failure

scenarios.reasoning: The agent was efficient (only 2 tool calls for data, completed in ~32s), correctly identified all key aspects of the build failure, and provided a helpful root-cause hypothesis about a missing build dependency. The only minor shortcoming is abbreviating the full file path, but all critical information was conveyed clearly.
